reviews.review: The best and the nicest instructor that I've had so far

One of the most pointless classes here, but an easy, and I mean EASY A if you need to take a lab science.
This class consists of a weekly lab where you basically plot a bunch of graphs from data tables, very similar to a first or second grade math class. They make sure to give you a lot of data though, so the plotting takes the majority of the time of the lab block.

Natalia is an incredible TA. Lab with her was really easy to understand and she answered questions without directly giving us answers to the questions in the lab. The lab manual is recommended but you can find it online and print it out. She does a short lecture before starting the lab to explain the concepts and sends out google docs with tips on answering the questions. She is Colombian and has a little bit of an accent but you can still clearly understand everything she says

Chris, Akarsh, Natalia and Jhayron are kind and considerate TAs who truly care about their students well-being. I took this lab asynchronously online with AOSC200, and I have no regrets. Taking a weather lab online cuts a significant amount of time out of your schedule compared to taking it in person during the year, as the online labs provide you with most of the measurements of weather and all you have to do is compute formulas and analyze what they mean. There are 12 labs total, with 4 per week if taken during the 3 week winter session. Your lowest graded lab is dropped. The TAs go above and beyond in emailing students back in a timely fashion, and the daily office hours are fruitful in checking your lab before submitting it. Overall, this is the lab you want to take if in need of a DSNL without having it strain your regular schedule. It’s a good amount of work, but entirely worth it.

Great guy. Very approachable and you could always ask questions on any and everything during the lab and he would always clarify in a way such that you ended up feeling confident in both the concepts and the answers you put down. If you're ever unsure, just ask and he's happy to help.
Awesome instructor- definitely enjoyed his section because of how helpful and insightful he was. Even got to know him a bit just cause he's a very approachable guy.

Gillian was a great TA. I had her for lab and she was super helpful when I had questions about certain problems. It was her first time teaching and she did great! She also sent out review slides for the AOSC200 final to help anyone still taking the class who was studying which was super nice and helpful!
She was awesome for lab, answering any questions about the lab and would often times discuss how it would be graded to make sure students would get the most points for the lab.

Wonderful TA. She's so kind to the students and really cared about how we were doing in both her class and the main AOSC200 one. I had her as my TA for AOSC200 as well, and she was really generous with project grades and helpful with preparing for the final exam.
Very easy lab, Gillian made sure to answer all questions well and gave us tips for most questions before we started the assignments. Was usually finished in half of the time given for the lab.
As long as you show up you should get a good grade. She goes over the lab in a mini lecture and then helps you with any questions you are stuck on

Don't take lab with him he grades so harshly. My friends who had the other TA (the women) had easier labs with fewer questions and basically got a 100 on each one. VINCENT does not do that. he takes off so many points.

Vincent Ferrera has no idea what he is doing in the course. It's like somehow he accidentally landed this job at UMD with no intent of being helpful. Every time you ask him a question he avoids it to the top degree by answering your question with his own and answering his own proposed question. The lab is from 3:30 - 5:30, but it would be common to leave around 6 every time. Vincent Ferrera does not care about the course or it's content and will just return sassy comments when asked to be helpful.

The labs were sometimes tedious but never super hard, he can be a strict grader but he is very helpful if you ask him questions during the lab. As long as you go to lab every week and try your best you should end with an A.
Very easy lab, partially because Gillian is so friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful. Show up and you will get an A.
The labs were sometimes tedious but not too difficult for a lab science. He is kind of a hard grader but will explain the problems throughout the class time.

Siyu is fantastic! Even though he is strict about deadlines, he is ALWAYS walking around to help us in class. I can definitely finish the lab questions in class with his guidance. I don't need to spend a single minute after class and get an A eventually!

Siyu is nice and helpful in class. He was always walking around in the classroom and helping us. He organized the class efficiently and every student can finish the material on time. I never spent extra time after class, as he promised. I was worried when I found out I had to take a lab class, but this one has been pretty great.
Siyu is super patient and helpful! It's easy to get an A if you understand what you're doing in the lab.
this guy sucks, he grades so terribly, and he doesn't give proper instructions
This guy was good. Easy grader, just follow the rubric.

As long as you follow the rubrics and his rules, you can get a satisfactory grade. In fact, these are the basic requirements of the course, not HIS own strict rules. He always helps us in class and gives us a lot of hints. As long as he/she can attend class on time and hand in the handouts, everyone can get a high score.
Lowkey and NPC, but the class isn't hard
Great TA, great guy/ Really helps his students if they struggle and wants them to get as many points as they can. Hope nothing but the best for him, and if he TAs again: you are in good hands.

Helpful until you don't know the problem you're trying to solve in your paper. He just goes over slides and makes us stay for 2 hours, doing the entire packet on a worksheet. Questions can range within difficulty levels but he would be here to help you at always.

Amazing TA! The lab consists of packets with mostly free response questions. She was very approachable and open to answering any questions we had. When I missed a lab due to illness she was understanding and let me make it up in her office. The discussion had a few projects (group & individual) but she was an easy grader. AOSC200 had some confusing concepts but she took time before each exam to explain more in depth. I would highly recommend choosing her! Left with a 99%.

Gabby is a great TA! She is extremely understanding and really cares about weather/climate. The lab was definitely long and took work, but Gabby was always there to answer questions thoroughly. Some of the labs were really fun, too. If you have to take this lab, definitely pick Gabby.

Lab for this class was absolutely horrendous but, having Gabby as a TA made it a bit more tolerable. She's so sweet and never made me feel bad for finishing late. She was so helpful when it came to answering questions! 

The actual labs were so boring and are just packets that you fill out for like 2 hours but, that's not Gabby's fault! Love her!!

name: AOSC201
title: Weather and Climate Laboratory
description: Corequisite: AOSC200. Formerly: METO201. Laboratory exercises to supplement AOSC200, including weather observations, weather map analysis, use of the Internet, forecasting practice and climate modeling. Students must pay a $60.00 lab materials fee.
